Name: Fairy Cocktail Recipe

✨ Fairy Cocktail (CP)[b]"A sparkling pink potion infused with cranberries and fairy rose petals — brings good fortune to anyone who drinks it."[/b] 🧚‍♀️🍸
[line]💖 About the ModThe [b]Fairy Cocktail[/b] is a magical new drink added to Stardew Valley.
It’s a glowing pink martini that shimmers with enchantment, blending Stardew Valley charm with a touch of fairy elegance.
Crafted as a [b]Content Patcher[/b] mod, this cocktail fits perfectly into the game’s cooking system
